title: Mycoplasma testing of cell cultures
summary: PCR-based screening for the most common silent contamination of mammalian cultures. Run monthly on every line.

reagents.name: Mycoplasma PCR detection kit (PromoKine, Lonza, etc.)
Conditioned media from each test line

hazardsMd: Standard PCR + EtBr gel hazards. Conditioned media is BSL-2 — handle in BSC.
contentUndergrad:
## Why monthly
Mycoplasma doesn't change media color and is invisible under bright-field. It silently shifts gene expression and growth rates, ruining experiments. PCR catches it weeks before any visible symptom.

steps.title: Collect conditioned media
steps.instructionMd: Take 100 μL of conditioned media from a flask that's been at confluence for ≥48 hours (peak mycoplasma yield). Skip cells that were fed in the last 24 h.
steps.verificationMd: Media samples labeled with line, passage, date. Stored on ice or at 4 °C if not running same-day.

steps.title: Spin to remove cells
steps.instructionMd: Spin 500×g / 5 min. Transfer 50 μL supernatant to a new tube — this is your PCR template.
steps.verificationMd: Pellet visible at the bottom of the spun tube. Supernatant clear.

steps.title: Set up PCR
steps.instructionMd: Per kit. Include positive control (provided) and negative control (water). Run cycle per kit (typically 35 cycles).
steps.verificationMd: All wells loaded. Positive + negative controls clearly labeled and bracketed.

steps.title: Run gel
steps.instructionMd: Run PCR products on 1.5% agarose gel. Look for the diagnostic ~280 bp band (kit-specific).
steps.verificationMd: Positive control shows expected band. Negative control is clean.

steps.title: Interpret + log
steps.instructionMd: Any test line showing the diagnostic band = MYCOPLASMA POSITIVE. Quarantine the line, decontaminate the incubator, and rebuild from a frozen stock from a clean passage. Log results in the cell-line registry.
steps.safetyNotesMd: Positive lines must NOT continue in shared incubators. Move to a quarantine incubator or autoclave immediately.
steps.verificationMd: All test lines have a clear positive/negative call. Registry updated. Action plan written for any positive lines.
